name: Back Squat
cues: Brace core, chest up, knees track over toes. Break at the hip and knee simultaneously. Reach depth where hip crease is below the top of the knee.
common_errors: Forward lean due to weak core or tight ankles
Rising on toes — cue: spread the floor with your feet

name: Deadlift
cues: Neutral spine, bar over mid-foot, hinge at the hips before bending the knees. Drive the floor away. Squeeze glutes at lockout.
common_errors: Bar drifting away from the body

name: Bench Press
cues: Retract scapulae, feet flat on floor. Bar path touches lower chest. Drive through the bar, not just the chest.
common_errors: Losing arch — keep moderate natural arch, not forced

name: Pull-Up
cues: Depress scapulae before pulling. Lead with chest to the bar, not chin. Full hang at bottom for full range of motion.
common_errors: Not depressing the scapula at the start

name: Romanian Deadlift (RDL)
cues: Hip hinge movement. Soft knee bend, neutral spine. Feel stretch in hamstrings at bottom. Do not round the back.
common_errors: Treating it like a conventional deadlift (too much knee bend)
Losing neutral spine at the bottom

name: Overhead Press (OHP)
cues: Bar starts at collar bone. Press in a slight arc over the head. Squeeze glutes to protect lower back. Do not hyperextend at lockout.

name: Dumbbell Row
cues: Brace on bench or knee. Drive elbow toward hip, not out to side. Squeeze the back at the top. Full stretch at the bottom.
common_errors: Pulling with the bicep instead of the back

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
cues: Front foot far enough forward that the shin is vertical at the bottom. Lower hips straight down. Front heel stays flat.
common_errors: Front foot too close (knee caves forward)
Hip instability — cue: think about sitting into the hip

name: Plank
cues: Neutral spine — no sagging hips or piked hips. Breathe steadily. Squeeze glutes and brace abs as if expecting a punch.

name: Hip Thrust
cues: Upper back on bench, barbell over hips with pad. Drive hips up until body forms a straight line. Squeeze glutes hard at the top. Chin tucked.
common_errors: Hyperextending the lower back at the top
